title: Irish Beef Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Indian-inspired beef stew made with tender beef, charred spices, and a hint of zesty flavor. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside. Add the cumin seeds and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger, tomato paste, and flour to the pot. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the stout and beef broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil. Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
